MT-Yellowstone-Assignments.auction_format: Annual lien assignment lottery each August; remaining liens assigned first-come, first-served afterward
MT-Yellowstone-Assignments.sale_status: Rolling delinquent tax-lien list (two-year window plus additional properties)

MT-Yellowstone-Assignments.winning_rate_mechanism: Interest rate is fixed by statute; August lottery determines tax-code assignment order, remaining liens go first-come, first-served
MT-Yellowstone-Assignments.redemption_period: 3 years from the date the lien attaches (MCA 15-18-111)
MT-Yellowstone-Assignments.important_rules: Tax liens are not tax deeds. A tax-deed process requires the 3-year statutory redemption period to expire. Published Total Due figures exclude accrued penalty and interest.
